settings.question: How quickly will I see results?
settings.answer: Most customers notice a feeling of lightness within the first wear as stagnant fluid starts to move. Visible skin texture improvement typically begins around week 2–3 of daily wear. Structural changes — the real reduction in dimpling — are most visible at 6–8 weeks of consistent use.

settings.question: I've tried leggings before. Why is this different?
settings.answer: Standard compression leggings squeeze superficially, which can actually restrict circulation and worsen the appearance of cellulite over time. Veloura's VELO-LYMPH™ fabric uses 47 mapped micro-pressure points engineered to stimulate lymphatic flow with every step — it works with your body's movement, not against it.

settings.question: How do I find the right size?
settings.answer: We recommend sizing up if you're between sizes for maximum comfort during all-day wear. Our size guide is available on the product image gallery. When in doubt, the fabric has 4-way stretch to accommodate.

settings.question: How long does shipping take?
settings.answer: UK standard shipping: 3–5 business days. UK express: 1–2 business days. EU: 5–8 days. International: 7–14 days. All orders over £65 include free standard UK shipping.

settings.question: Can I wear them every day?
settings.answer: Absolutely — and we encourage it. The clinical results are cumulative: the more consistently you wear them, the better the structural improvement. Machine wash cold, hang dry. They maintain their therapeutic properties for 80+ washes.

settings.question: What if they don't work for me?
settings.answer: We offer a 30-day Clinical Trial Guarantee. If you don't see measurable improvement in skin texture within 30 days of daily wear, contact us for a full refund — no returns required, no questions asked.
